sections.heading: Pitch Overview
sections.text: Prepared on 4 April 2025, pitch SYN-SYNCP000093-P1 was put before Riverbend Physician Alliance 093 on behalf of Supplier.

sections.heading: Put Forward in Exchange
sections.text: In exchange the Supplier put forward a Band 2 rebate of 3 per cent.

sections.heading: Sought in Return
sections.text: The Supplier sought a yearly Influenza minimum take of 1,670 doses in return.

sections.heading: Recorded Result
sections.text: Recorded result: the Customer signed off on the terms.
